row.description: One credits line: a role on the left (dim, right-aligned) and a name on the right (bright, left-aligned). A row whose role AND name are both empty strings is a SPACER -- it renders as a blank gap instead of a text line, which is how the shipped list groups leads / UI+art / designers / programmers. Either column alone may be empty (a second name under one role, say); both empty is the spacer case.

name.description: The person's name, rendered bright in the right column via the credits.name string template.

role.description: The role/job title, rendered dim in the right-aligned left column via the credits.role string template.

description: data/ui/credits.json: the CREDITS screen's (role, name) row list -- the one place the shipped credit roll is stated. An ORDERED array, rendered top to bottom exactly as authored (unlike strings.json's closed key set, rows are designer-owned content: adding a person is a data edit, never a schema change). Loaded + validated at boot (game/main.py) and passed to game.ui.credits.configure_credits, which rebinds the module's row list in place; the unconfigured module default equals this file's stock content (the fonts.json/palette.json/strings.json convention). Edited through the editor's selector > ui > Credits leaf (editor/panels/credits_panel.py) -- never by hand. The screen shrinks its line step to fit more rows, down to the font's own line height; past that the list overflows the 640x360 surface, which the editor panel warns about but no schema can express.

rows.description: The credit rows, in render order, top first.
